consolidation.method: Initial consolidation merged verified recovery inputs into source/recovered-words.csv and reduced historical summaries to locale labels/grouping. The later verified refresh is recorded separately below.

verifiedRefresh.method: Checked the external canonical snapshot against its checksum inventory, independently rehashed every candidate, verified all original row metadata and the unrecovered complement, and imported through tools/import_recoveries.py. All previous candidates preserved; original hash table unchanged.
verifiedRefresh.privacy: External evidence is identified by content digests rather than personal-machine paths or obsolete local filenames. It is not bundled with the repository.

currentDigests: npm run data:build records exact current source digests in public/data/dataset.json.
coverage: coverage.json records historical attack coverage separately from imported recovery data.
